svg.text: Operators chained in one stage are compiled
Replaces each supported operator with a Gpu*
version, adds GPU<->CPU transitions. Data is
cuDF columns; an expression tree is evaluated
node by node, one cuDF call each.
expressions. Translates the tree to CUDA C++,
compiles it with NVRTC, runs one kernel.
Anything unsupported stays as spark-rapids had it.
Same results bit for bit as spark-rapids (the reference); each plugin decision, fused or not, is logged with its reason.
Case C on 1 x L20: filter + project operator time 0.145 -> 0.053 task-s, but the whole query stays at ~0.71-0.72 s (reading and writing Parquet dominate).
